landing.title: Know the risk on your street — before it arrives.
landing.subtitle: ResQGrid reads live rainfall, river levels, terrain, official advisories and citizen reports, predicts disaster risk for each city and district and tells you exactly what to do.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for the moments that matter
landing.f1d: Rain, river discharge, elevation and slope combined into a 0–100 score for every locality.
landing.f2d: Machine learning flags sudden spikes in rainfall and river levels before they become emergencies.
landing.f3d: Location-based warnings with clear actions, in English, Hindi and Marathi.
landing.f4d: Photos are checked by an image AI and cross-verified with sensor data and nearby reports.
landing.f5d: One screen for risk zones, report triage, resources and broadcast alerts.
landing.f6d: Routes to the nearest shelter that steer around high-risk zones.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.none: No alerts right now. Stay safe!

flood: Move to upper floors or higher ground now
Avoid walking or driving through flood water — 15 cm can knock you down
Switch off electricity at the main if water enters
Keep your phone charged and follow official updates
landslide: Move away from steep slopes, hill bases and ghat roads
Watch for cracks, tilting trees or sudden muddy streams
Avoid travel on ghat roads until cleared
Evacuate immediately if you hear rumbling
heatwave: Stay indoors between 12 pm and 4 pm
Drink water regularly, even if not thirsty
Check on elderly neighbours and children
Seek medical help for dizziness or confusion
storm: Secure loose objects on balconies and terraces
Stay away from trees, hoardings and power lines
Keep a torch and power bank ready
other: Stay alert and follow official instructions
general: Stay alert and follow official instructions
